E0001.title: unexpected character
E0001.explanation: The source contains a character or word that the toy language does not define.

E0002.title: expected expression
E0002.explanation: A statement must start with print, and print must be followed by a value.

E0003.title: expected closing parenthesis or end of line
E0003.explanation: An opening parenthesis was not closed, or a statement continues after a complete expression.

E0004.title: integer literal out of range
E0004.explanation: The literal does not fit in a 32-bit signed integer.
